elements.element: On expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: The added paragraph applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Statement of Work for any reason” and requires Contractor, at Company's request, to provide transition assistance.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly requires transition assistance “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The assistance is expressly priced “at Contractor's then-current rates.”

elements.element: On expiry or termination, Vendor must return Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Contractor must “return all Company data in Contractor's possession or control.” Company and Contractor correspond to Customer and Vendor, respectively.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The return deadline is “within thirty (30) days after such expiry or termination.”

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly requires return “in a standard machine-readable format.”

elements.element: After returning Customer Data, Vendor must delete it.
elements.evidence: The clause requires Contractor to “thereafter delete such data from its systems.”

elements.element: After deletion, Vendor must certify the deletion.
elements.evidence: Contractor must “certify such deletion in writing” after deleting the returned data.

elements.element: On expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: The added paragraph creates a transition-assistance obligation upon expiry or termination, exercisable at Company's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for 90 days.
elements.evidence: Assistance is available for any requested period up to six months, which includes 90 days.

elements.element: On expiry or termination, Vendor must export Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: The required return of all Company data in a standard machine-readable format constitutes a data export.

elements.element: Customer Data must be exported within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause requires the machine-readable return within thirty days after expiry or termination.

result.reason: The operative language satisfies every preferred and fallback requirement. However, it applies upon termination of any single Statement of Work and then requires return and deletion of all Company data, without limiting the obligation to data associated with the terminated Statement of Work. If other Statements of Work remain active, this could impair their continued performance. That overbroad scope is more than necessary and may conflict with the agreement's continuing commercial operation.
